title: Asahina Mafuyu — Looking Up At The Same Moon〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Looking Up At The Same Moon（2★）

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I finished my homework quicker than expected.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I need to complete the first draft of those lyrics today too...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not like I have anything else to do, so I guess I'll log on.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Is it just you and Amia here right now, K...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, but I'm sure Enanan will be here soon.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, just a minute ago she said, Finally done with classes! I'm beat...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Finally, I'm done with classes. I'm so tired...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, you're back.
Also, you sent us a message saying pretty much the same thing like a minute ago.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Go easy on me, will you? I'm really tired...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, more importantly, mind taking a look at this...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know, right? This is why I got a phone with a nighttime lens built-in!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, you're right!
Anybody get up to any moon viewing tonight?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <My mom bought us some dango, so I might have some later.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, now? Aren't you watching your weight?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'm watching my calorie intake, but there's no harm in having a couple.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Me? I had some moon viewing dango after dinner, but they sort of ended up becoming ohagi...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What about you, K? Do anything good?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, the girl who comes to clean my house left me some dango in the freezer. I warmed them up just now and tried some.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She even separated them into little bags, so that it's easy for me to defrost them in individual batches...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Interesting. You care more about that than how they taste...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I see the moon every night anyway.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That may be true, but it's not really just about that, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, we can probably still get a good look at the moon, so why don't we all take a quick peek?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, you mean right now? Okay, sure...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I doubt I'll feel anything by doing this...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Just humor me, will you?
I mean, what if you're just overcome with emotion after seeing how beautiful it is?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No, not that!
How awful can someone be at reading a situation?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It has this sort of blurry outline that makes it seem like it's about to fade away into the night sky...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's kinda blurred from where I'm sitting too. It is a little cloudy, but this might work in terms of design.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, I get that sense from where I am too!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How we're all in different places right now, but looking up towards the same moon.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's like something straight out of one of those really girly romance comics...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It'd be even more romantic if we were scattered all over the world or something!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But depending on where you are, like the other side of the world, you wouldn't be able to see the moon...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Details♪ Details♪
That's not what's important right now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The fact is that you're doing a moon viewing right now, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Is that why you wanted us to do this?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. My plan went off without a hitch♪>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But all we did was look at it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for your suggestion, Amia. It was a breath of fresh air.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'm glad you enjoyed it.
Anyway, I'm gonna get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I feel like I should thank you.>
